title: A4 gaps: non-main-goroutine panics, MultiWriter stderr failure, and a racy pidfile Claim/Release
body: From reading the code, not reproduced: the recover at cli.go:386-397 covers only the main goroutine, so other goroutines' panics and fatal errors leave no cause and no run_died. io.MultiWriter(stderr, log) at cli.go:367 stops writing run.log when stderr is broken. Claim (runlife.go:88-105) is check-then-rename with no exclusion, and Release removes the pidfile without checking ownership. No test drives a real run-epic through signal, panic or error and asserts on run_died.
